source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Have a look at the records from the initial inspection.
3. Remember to discuss the issues with tenants and staff.
4. Make sure you identify ALL fire risks.
5. Be sure to include potential risk areas.
6. Take lots of photos of issues with fire safety.
7. Always provide a concise summary of the violations.
8. Always suggest corrective actions.
9. Make sure you dot all the I’s and cross all the T’s.<eos>
